design.name: immutable_closure_frame
design.rule: Every followed callable carries at most one ClosureFrame: frozen (literal_env, binding_map, bound_params, resolved_node). Frames are created exactly when the factory/partial/helper binding is recorded, using the statement snapshot at that creation call. Invocation only extends the frame with parameter slots; it never re-runs bind_literal against the outer invocation environment for captured defaults.

ClosureFrame.binding_map: shallow copy of binding map at creation statement
ClosureFrame.bound_params: bind_literal result or explicit miss map when bind_literal returns None
ClosureFrame.node: AST helper body to follow (may differ from callable_info static local[returned] after prefix replay)
ClosureFrame.bind_status: bound | miss (miss forces sweep_body / lead-only for that closure; never fall through to module env for parameters)

creation_sites: assignment_binding / update_bindings when callable_info returns capture_owner + capture_call: compute frame at capture_call id via call_env/binding_env from the same prepare_eval_calls that classified the cell
assignment_binding for functools.partial spawn aliases: frame holds fixed_nodes/fixed_keywords literals evaluated at partial construction env
ordinary helper binding: frame absent; follow_helper continues to bind at call site (unchanged)

consumption.follow_helper: If binding carries closure_frame: seed body_env/body_bindings from frame; skip spawn_scan capture overlay. If bind_status is miss: return None (sweep). Else bind only invoke-time args atop frame.bound_params.
consumption.callable_info: Stop selecting nested def by static local[returned]; store resolved node on frame after prefix replay at creation time only.

threading_unification.optional: Replace parallel (env, call_env, bindings, binding_env) quadruple with EnvPair(literal, bindings) plus per-node statement snapshots; spawn_scan reads cenv/cbindings only through get_site(node) -> EnvPair. Not required for F1–F3 fix but deletes four-parameter drift.
